baseFrontend: validated Admin 7 runtime with NexoWatt EOS compact login, role, overview and service-reserve hardening
label: v91
notes: 7.9.91 is the accepted stable sales-product release and is intended for npm dist-tag latest.
The normal login uses a compact two-layer card; the outer card no longer inherits full-viewport form sizing.
Installer, Guest and User empty-password first activation is enabled only after a server-side eligibility check.
After personal password setup, empty-password sign-in stays disabled until an authorized reset reopens activation.
Installer and end-user overview tiles use direct navigation handlers and remain fully clickable.
The internal admin and BackItUp emergency reserve are hidden for non-admin roles even when service rows render asynchronously.
NexoWatt Backup remains available to approved roles; EOS Assist stays in the header and the default port stays 8081.
changes: Scopes login form styling to the inner card and keeps the rear card compact instead of viewport-high.
Adds a login-layout regression guard for CSS source/build parity and compact sizing invariants.
Keeps the narrow passwordless-status endpoint for server-authoritative first-activation button state.
Keeps direct overview navigation and hard internal-reserve row filtering for Installer and End User.
Preserves Admin/Service-only expert mode, internal admin and BackItUp reserve access.
Publishes the stable package through npm latest with exact version and package validation.
